_doc: Static directory of the hackathon agent team. The LIVE roster is whatever is connected: `python agents/cli.py roster` or GET http://127.0.0.1:8890/roster. Keep this file as the source of truth for names/roles/topics so every component addresses the right agent.

armsmith-web.desc: Web port of the Unity ARMSMITH SO-101 arm sim. Physics, IK, scenarios, stall detector, recorder.

fake-sim.desc: Deterministic protocol-complete stub sim with injectable faults. For testing controllers with no browser.

mujoco.desc: The training physics engine. Same scenarios as the web sim; used for policy rollouts and evaluation.

stall-controller.desc: The learning loop's conductor: deterministic stall detector at tick rate -> Laya System-1 identification -> (Jev gate) -> local GLM System-2 reasoning on stall -> validates and issues the recovery -> labels the outcome.

laya.desc: System 1: fast, calibrated identification of progress / failure mode / recoverability.

jev.desc: Optional cheap pre-gate: 'is this stall worth waking System 2?' Needs network. Skipped automatically when offline.

glm-s2.engine: Ollama glm-4.7-flash-abl:alexei-v3 (18 GB, local, AMD iGPU)
glm-s2.desc: System 2: stall reasoner. Diagnoses the stall dossier and returns a bounded, symbolic recovery plan. Never outputs joint angles.

hand-tracker.desc: Camera -> 21 landmarks -> pinch/fist -> retargeted end-effector target.

tape-tracker.desc: The blue-tape robot lineage, generalised to any colour marker; emits a steering signal.

marker-pose.desc: Metric 6-DoF pose of AprilTag/ArUco markers in the camera frame.

codex.desc: The builder: writes/fixes sim, retargeting, training and deployment code. Works through a shell, so it drives the bus with agents/cli.py. Reads AGENTS.md at the repo root automatically.

orchestrator.desc: Plans, delegates to Flash workers, reviews. The human's chief of staff.

gut-trainer.desc: Trains + gates the robot-ops domain from the controller's labelled stalls so System 1 learns what System 2 taught it.

blender.desc: Generates/repairs 3D assets for the sim scene (props, target zones), URDF->GLB conversion.
